//: Shared TypeScript settings for client/, server/, and desktop/.
MIGRATION STATE: loose on purpose. allowJs lets .js and .ts coexist so the
codebase is never in a half-converted broken state, and strict is off so
converted files do not have to satisfy strict null checks on day one.
Strict flags are enabled one at a time in Phase 8, once conversion is done.
Do NOT flip strict:true here mid-migration — it turns every unconverted
boundary into an error at once.
